name: ai-gig-matcher
description: AI gig matcher that inventories your deliverable skills, researches real platform rules and rates, then matches gig directions with bidding scripts and a first-delivery workflow.

profession.zh: AI 接单匹配与报价顾问

defaultInitPrompt.en: I can write copy and want to earn money by taking gigs with AI. Help me match gig directions and platforms.
